title: 全球公民之思
text:
今天的阳光格外灿烂，照亮了繁忙的国际机场。人们携带行李穿梭于不同国境，这种流动性揭示了一个深刻议题。在数字化时代，全球公民的概念逐渐被大众提及。它不仅指持有多种护照的人，更代表一种超越国界的认同感。
这种观念主张个体应关注全人类共同利益。气候变化、流行病等挑战已不再是单一国家的难题。面对危机，协作取代竞争成为生存关键。然而，这种理想主义在现实中遭遇了挑战。部分学者担忧，过分强调全球化会导致本土文化被稀释。
如果人们忘记根源，社会可能会陷入精神空虚。传统价值观提供了心理支撑，而普世价值则拓展视野。两者并非水火不容，而是互为补充。真正的国际视野应当建立在深厚文化底蕴之上。
我们应当在尊重差异的前提下寻找共识。接纳多元观点能有效消除偏见，减少冲突。这种心态促使个体从狭隘立场转向宽广胸怀。它要求我们意识到，每一个人都是地球村的成员。
责任感是这一身份的核心。这意味着在享受便利时，也要承担起维护生态的义务。通过教育引导青年一代培养同理心，能让世界更和谐。未来的竞争将不再是资源的争夺，而是智慧的融合。
在这个互联的世界里，孤立主义已无法解决实际困难。只有构建开放心态，才能应对日益复杂的局势。重新定义公民身份，有助于推动文明进步。这不仅是学术讨论，更是时代要求。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does the concept of "global citizen" represent, beyond simply holding multiple passports?
options: A legal status granted only by the United Nations
A marketing term aimed at frequent travelers
An identity that transcends national borders
A formal requirement for international employment

questions.prompt: According to the text, what concern do some scholars raise about over-emphasizing globalization?
options: That it will slow down economic growth worldwide
That local culture will be diluted
That international travel will become more expensive
That international cooperation will decrease

questions.prompt: According to the text, how do traditional values and universal values relate to one another?
options: Traditional values are always superior to universal ones
Universal values should replace traditional ones entirely
They are complementary rather than mutually exclusive
They are completely incompatible and must be chosen between

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is identified as the core of the global citizen identity?
options: Wealth accumulation
A sense of responsibility
Political power
Linguistic fluency in multiple languages

questions.prompt: According to the text's conclusion, what will future competition be centered on, rather than resource grabbing?
options: Military dominance
Territorial expansion
Currency manipulation
The fusion/integration of wisdom

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
